summaries.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: cross-session memory for the model. Full-text search all past sessions (SQLite FTS5 via ctx.sessionQuery) and bring the strongest matching excerpts back into the current context — recall earlier decisions, commands, and mistakes.
